decisions.reason: F4 incorrectly included the empty chain in the union upper-bound claim. The initial eigenfamily is an element of the inclusion poset and bounds the empty chain; nonempty chain unions remain orthonormal extensions. Repaired F4 and its choice boundary. Weighted spectral integrals, the literal A rho domain condition and the bounded adjoint closure prove (a)-(c) without unbounded cyclicity.

Clauses (a) and (d)(ii) wrongly confine AC to Coulomb construction although adopted P2/P4/P5 explicitly assume it. Both clauses now distinguish the CC-only bounded realization from inherited general spectral/evolution AC. P7 is now a direct physical-assumption supplier for the already stated apparatus and parameter qualifications. Spatial domains, finite-mode operators, species sectors, units and all energy assignments remain unchanged.

Clause (c) invokes P7 for temperature and apparatus identifications but omitted that supplier from deps and dependency_roles. Added P7 explicitly with its declared comparison, calibration and empirical-input conditions; this supplies a discipline for comparisons, not a temperature measurement or thermometer theorem. Finite-sector entropy bounds and free-energy identities retain their exact mathematical suppliers and unchanged formulas.

The Statement requires the spatial realization of the declared fixed-N model, not arbitrary bounded functions. That supplier Definition (b)(i) and (c)(i) explicitly require real measurable bounded V_ext and W, with even W. Thus the direct/exchange supplier (c) and the H2-domain realization have all measurability hypotheses. Checked spin transport, product H2 domains, vanishing one-body cross terms, real exchange integrals and Coulomb X >= 0; no item edit is warranted.

Clause (c) omitted the unit of its positive beta parameter although assigned energies are in joules. It now quantifies positive inverse-energy beta in J^-1, leaving every numerical partition identity and energy bound unchanged. Checked orthogonal sector bases, trace multiplicities, negative energies, zero fermion sector and equality exactly on the ground eigenspace. This is a dimensional declaration defect, not a false finite spectral calculation.

Original step 1.3 used undefined number-variable b_n and credited fixed-N bases plus a bosonic-only direct-sum theorem with an unconstructed fermionic Hilbert realization. Steps 1.3 and 2.1 now define both degree sums, prove fermionic completeness and the union occupation basis locally, specify exact diagonal H/N/G domains and core closure, and identify the positive trace through exhaustive finite-support products. F2 then proves both criteria, including finite negative fermionic shifts. The unsupported continuum aside is replaced with an explicit source-scope limit. The original theorem formulas and scope are preserved.

Checked the two eigenvectors, shift cancellation, partition Z_h, mean, entropy and free energy. No item edit is needed.
